purpose: Future concept mockups, fictional demonstration data; no app or backend changes

prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a premium, extremely legible high-fidelity iOS app design presentation for Heiro, a private family memory app. Landscape 3:2 composition, two large upright iPhone screen mockups side by side, minimal thin black device bezels, no perspective, no fingers, no desk. Fill most of canvas with the screens; modest title and captions. Warm ivory canvas #F5F4EF, white app surfaces, deep pine #153F38 headings, teal #00858B interactive controls, restrained warm gold accents. Modern humanist sans typography for UI, larger warm editorial serif only for special story headings. Strong contrast, generous spacing but realistic compact mobile screens, precise crisp text and consistent line icons. Use fully fictional demo family photos and names. Small unobtrusive footer outside devices reads "HEIRO • FUTURE CONCEPT • FICTIONAL DEMO". Not a generic bank dashboard, no glossy neon or excessive gradients, no decorative clutter. Both screens with authentic 9:41 status bar and safe area. Do not promise lifetime/unlimited storage or actual measured performance.
BOARD TITLE: "Everyday moments. Lasting stories."
LEFT SCREEN label above device "01 / FAMILY FEED". App top header small organic tree mark and "Heiro", plus in teal circle, settings gear. Family selector circular tiny family image, "The Hart family", chevron. Compact segmented tabs "Feed" active, "Tree", "My vault". Search row "Find a person, place or story". Modest compact warm pale-gold prompt strip "This week's question" with "What made your childhood home special?" and a small mic icon. Main premium feed post: "Mum" avatar, "Today · Family", ellipsis. Story title "Sunday at Nana's". Two short caption lines "Three generations, one very full kitchen." Large beautiful natural candid photograph of an older grandmother and two adult relatives cooking in a bright lived-in kitchen, sunlit warm tones. Beneath image carousel dots and "1/3". Integrated slim voice playback card with triangular play, waveform, "Nana tells the story", "1:24". Post actions "Love" and "Add a memory". Bottom shows only top of another post with subtle date divider, suggesting natural scrolling. Keep feed dominant, not gamified or salesy.
RIGHT SCREEN label "02 / ADD A MEMORY". Top "Cancel", centered "New memory", teal "Share" button. Author avatar "You", visibility pill "Family" with chevron, explicit destination row "Share to The Hart family". Content field with entered demo title "Sunday at Nana's", short caption "The recipe she never writes down." Two chosen photo thumbnails with remove X at top right each, third dashed tile "+", caption "2 of 20 photos". A clean horizontal attachment toolbar THREE equally readable items "Camera", "Photos", "Voice". Section "Voice notes" includes two independently removable playable rows named "Nana's recipe" duration1:24 with pencil, and "The secret ingredient" duration0:38 with pencil, and button "+ Record another". Light compact row "People in this memory" with Mum/Nana chips and +. At lower portion a subtle check icon with "Draft saved on this phone", then restrained secondary "Save draft". Everything aligned and easy for older eyes, no keyboard visible. Share is visibly the primary action; no forced vault destination.

BOARD TITLE: "Every person has a place. Every story has a home."
LEFT SCREEN label "03 / FAMILY TREE". Familiar family tree page: top back arrow, centered "Family tree", gear. Small family-photo selector "The Hart family". Search "Find someone", compact "Centre on me" control. Preserve a genealogical tree, no invented discovery feature, no globe, no AI suggested relatives. Clear fine connecting lines and portrait nodes. Visible top generation label "Grandparents" with Nana and Grandad paired. Next label "Parents" with Mum and Dad paired. Next middle label "Your generation" with You highlighted teal border and Noah as sibling clearly on SAME generation and visibly connected to the same parents. Beneath You next label "Children" with one child Ava connected vertically. Plus-outline node "Add relative" next to appropriate generation, not scattered all over. Plenty of room, readable labels, all portraits fictional. Bottom compact explanation "Showing your closest relatives" and unobtrusive zoom + / - controls. Non-overlapping relationships, familial clarity.
RIGHT SCREEN label "04 / A LIFE IN STORIES". A beautifully composed personal legacy profile for fictional Nana. Top back, title "Nana", menu. Wide hero header image, candid older woman gardening in afternoon sun. Profile portrait inset circular, headline "Margaret Hart", subtitle "Known to us as Nana", small line "Your grandmother". Button "Add a memory" in teal with small plus. A section "Hear her story" large horizontal voice highlight with her small photo, play, waveform, title "The garden she loved", duration1:42. Below slim anchored tabs "Memories" active, "About", "Media". Editorial story card with photo of a vintage garden, "1988", "A house full of roses" short description "Shared by Mum", small "View story" link. Next section heading glimpsed "Life chapters" with chips "Childhood", "Family", "Favourite places". All photos have subtle expand icon to indicate tap to enlarge. No form-like About prompts, no generic upload-VN terminology, no claim of resurrecting anyone.

BOARD TITLE: "Trust the stories. Share the space."
LEFT SCREEN label "05 / ASK THE FAMILY ARCHIVE". iOS chat header back, circular small Nana portrait with tiny sparkle badge, title "Nana's stories", subtitle "AI guide to saved memories", info icon. Calm ivory chat background. At top compact explanatory sentence "Answers come from memories shared with you." User bubble teal "Who taught Nana to bake?" Assistant white card "In her recording, Nana says her mum taught her to make the Sunday bread." Beneath a clearly tappable source card with audio icon, "Sunday in the kitchen", "Voice note · 02:14", play arrow, and small text "Shared by Mum". A second user message "What about her grandparents?" Assistant white bubble "No grandparents are linked to Nana yet, and there isn't a saved story about them." Small action button "Ask family to add a story". Bottom composer "Ask about a saved memory..." and send arrow. No roleplay pretending the AI is Nana, no fabricated relationships, no chat jumping shown, plenty of white space.
RIGHT SCREEN label "06 / FAMILY STORAGE". iOS back, centered "Family storage", subtle help. Elegant pale teal main card heading "Room for your family's stories", huge "35 GB", secondary "8.4 GB used · 3 contributors", visually correct 24% progress bar, small "26.6 GB available". Contributors section with three tidy rows, avatars, "You" "+5 GB" and status "Active", "Mum" "+25 GB" "Active", "Noah" "+5 GB" "Active". Keep arithmetic exact 5+25+5=35. Small line "Every active contribution supports this family." Section "This month's shared allowance" two compact rows "AI answers" "430 / 2,500" and "Voice-to-text" "38 / 640 min". A collapsed "What do these mean?" row. Primary wide teal button "Manage my contribution". Secondary line link "Compare 5 GB and 25 GB plans". Footer tiny but readable "Renewals keep your space available. Storage does not grow each month." Do not show prices or change prices. Don't add 0.5GB to paid family storage. Do not imply paying gives admin powers, data rights, or access to another family's private vault. Clean full page, no long pop-up.
